name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new tool, language or improvement
title: '[feature] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**Is your feature request related to a problem?**
A description of what's missing, e.g. "I'm always frustrated when [...]".

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What should Vajra OS do differently.

**Which area does it touch?**
- [ ] A new utility tool (which category: unique/finance/education/...)
- [ ] A core OS tool (core/)
- [ ] Buddhi AI (ai/)
- [ ] Language support (locale/)
- [ ] Kernel (kernel/)
- [ ] Branding (branding/)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Something else

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Any alternative solutions or features you've thought of.

**Additional context**
Anything else — screenshots, mockups, examples from other OSes.
